name: Skal Swap
author: Outcrop Labs
description: Menubar switcher for Claude Code providers — keys, endpoints, and per-endpoint model discovery — with optional usage readouts.

barWidget.description: Show and switch the active Claude Code provider profile and model.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Claude logomark tinted to the theme, a custom Nerd Font glyph, or no icon.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows next to the icon: profile name, endpoint host, or icon only.

schema.label: Icon glyph
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph used when the icon is set to Glyph (also used in toasts).
